_about: Strong funding opportunities that are NOT open yet, so they must not be published on the site. Held here with whatever signals tell us when the next round opens. When a call reopens, verify it on its official page, add it to the opportunities table (that is what publishes it), then set status to 'promoted' here. Source: ArtConnect 'Strongest Finds' shortlist, reviewed 7 Oct 2026. The two open ones from that shortlist (Bom Dia / OASis Residency 2027, Innovate Grant) are already live.

_fields.reopen_signal: When/how the next call is expected — what to watch for.
_fields.priority: high = act fast when it reopens; normal = add when noticed.
_fields.do_not_publish: true = not verified against an official current call; never publish until an official source is located and checked.
